steps:
WARNING: this add-in crashes the compiler every time it loads, until its DLL is removed. The IDE restarts the compiler, which loads the add-in and crashes again, and so on. Try it in an IDE whose add-ins you can restore.
1. Open rootfolder-parent-crash.twinproj in the twinBASIC IDE and build it (win32). Copy Build\RootfolderParentCrash_win32.dll into %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\ and restart the IDE.
2. Open any project. Expected: the DEBUG CONSOLE prints before Parent and then after Parent. Actual: it prints before Parent only, and the compiler crashes in the read of Host.FileSystem.RootFolder.Parent. The IDE restarts the compiler, which loads the add-in and crashes again (3 or 4 times in a run).
3. To get the IDE working again, close it and delete RootfolderParentCrash_win32.dll from %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\addins\win32\ (or move it out of that folder).
4. Control: in the add-in's Host_OnProjectLoaded, read Host.CurrentProject.RootFolder.Parent instead. It reads fine, and its Path is twinbasic:/. An add-in that reads neither does not crash.
Asserted on BETA 983, 995 and 997 by `addin-test.bat --only parent` (P21, the ParentProbe add-in in test/addin/probes/parent, of which this project is a cut-down copy).
